recipe.title: Sri Lankan chicken curry
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's 'Easy Weeknight Meals'.

method.s: Heat 2 Tbs oil in a wok or large pan on medium-high heat and fry onions with a pinch of salt for 4-5 minutes until golden. Add a Tbs of water if needed to prevent catching and burning.
Add another drizzle of oil, mustard seeds, curry powder, turmeric, garlic, ginger and 2-3 Tbs coconut milk. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes until very fragrant.
Stir in remaining coconut milk, coconut, crushed tomatoes, lemon juice and sugar, and bring to a gentle boil.

Add chicken, partially cover with a lid, and cook for about 10 minutes until nearly cooked through. Remove lid and continue simmering for a further 5 minutes to allow the sauce to reduce to quite thick.
Serve with rice and steamed green vegetables or sliced tomato and cucumber.
